# Alejololer: Carlos Alejandro Alemán Osorio

> Software Engineer based in Quito, Ecuador. Builds production web products with Python/Django, TypeScript/Next.js, Astro and LLMs, and builds fast, search-optimized websites (SEO, GEO, AEO) for small businesses in Ecuador.

Carlos Alejandro Alemán Osorio (online: Alejololer) is a Junior Software Engineer at Upstart 13, where he owns authentication and permissions, the data model and APIs, and the frontend architecture of an AI platform built on the Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL). He also built LLM features on the OpenAI API (Django, Next.js) that extract structured data from client documents and cut document drafting from days to hours. He holds a B.Eng. in Software Engineering from Escuela Politécnica Nacional (Quito, graduation grade 28/30) and two certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) and Claude Certified Developer: Foundations (Anthropic). Previously he was a Software Developer at Sagat Farm, where he was named Best Intern of the Cycle. He speaks Spanish (native) and English (professional).

What drives him: finding the friction people have learned to live with and replacing it with something simple. In his own words (Spanish): "Encuentro las fricciones que la gente ya aprendió a ignorar y las convierto en soluciones simples." He favors root causes over over-engineering, design with a recognizable aesthetic, and products people actually use.

## Freelance work
- Builds custom-designed websites for local businesses in Ecuador with Astro or Next.js, hosted on Vercel.
- Focus on local SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization: being cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity) and AEO (answer engine optimization: FAQ content with structured data).
- Contact: acarlosaleman03@gmail.com

## Websites built
- [Virtus Estudio Jurídico](https://virtusestudiojuridico.com): multidisciplinary law firm in Salcedo, Cotopaxi. Appeared on Google for 106 different search queries in its first two months, September to November 2026 (Google Search Console). Includes a free child-support calculator with PDF output.
- [Asia Motors Importadora](https://asia-motors-eta.vercel.app): official importer of Skyworth, Kenbo, 212 and FAW vehicles in Ecuador. Catalog, EV savings calculator, test drive booking and quotes. Built as a proposal; the client did not adopt it.
- [Con Cariño](https://con-carino.vercel.app): gift shop in Latacunga. Catalog and cart that sends orders to WhatsApp, with an admin panel.

## Open source
- [usdx-autochart](https://github.com/Alejololer/usdx-autochart): generates UltraStar Deluxe karaoke charts from audio.
- [shop-base](https://github.com/Alejololer/shop-base): reusable storefront + CMS template (Astro, Neon, WhatsApp checkout).
- [TripTikBot](https://github.com/Alejololer/TripTikBot): AI agent for finding travel experiences.
